objectives.title: Define, build and modify container images
Choose and use the right workload resource (Deployment, DaemonSet, CronJob, etc.)
Understand multi-container Pod design patterns (e.g. sidecar, init and others)
Use Kubernetes primitives to implement common deployment strategies (e.g. blue/green or canary)
Understand Deployments and how to perform rolling updates
Use the Helm package manager to deploy existing packages
Use built-in CLI tools to monitor Kubernetes applications
Discover and use resources that extend Kubernetes (CRD, Operators)
Understand authentication, authorization and admission control
Provide and troubleshoot access to applications via services
Use Ingress rules to expose applications

exam_price_notes: Certification exam only – $445; Certification exam + THRIVE-ONE Annual Subscription – $625; Certification exam + Kubernetes for Developers (LFD259) course – $645
exam_rules: Performance-based exam conducted in a live Kubernetes cluster terminal environment. Open-book: official documentation may be accessed during the exam at kubernetes.io, helm.sh, and github.com/kubernetes. No personal notes, unauthorized websites, or external resources permitted. No food or drink. Exam area must be clear of papers and unauthorized materials. Proctor monitors via webcam and screen share.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. ID must match the name on the exam registration. Acceptable forms include passport, driver's license, or national ID card.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-14: Linux Foundation CKAD product page live with pricing ($445 / $625 bundle) and enrolment.

prerequisites.description: Working knowledge of container runtimes and microservice architecture

recommended_experience: Working knowledge of container runtimes and microservice architecture
renewal_options: Certifications are valid for 2 years. Renewal requires retaking and passing the exam before expiry. No CE credit option — exam retake is the only renewal path.

retake_policy.notes: One free retake attempt is included with the exam purchase. A minimum 12-hour waiting period is required between attempts. The free retake must be used within 12 months of the original purchase.

target_audience: Cloud-native developers, DevOps engineers, and others beginning a cloud career

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored via PSI; no in-person test center required
